hero.eyebrow: The digital table for your tabletop RPG
hero.title: TOMEVAULT
hero.subtitle: One warm, calm table where GMs and players come together. Handouts, chat, battle order, notes and your whole world — realtime, without dashboard chaos.

handouts.title: Handouts without detours
handouts.description: Reveal lore, maps and clues at the right moment. Sealed until you roll open the scroll.

chat.title: Realtime at the table
chat.description: Chat, dice rolls and world status stay in sync for every player instantly.

combat.title: Battle order that keeps pace
combat.description: Initiative, HP, conditions and turns in one clear combat panel — premium and overview-friendly.

notes.title: Notes & chronicles
notes.description: Capture the world: private GM notes, shared chronicles and everything you look up later.

inventory.title: Inventory & loot
inventory.description: Manage items, currency and rewards. Players keep their backpack close at hand.

roles.title: GM and player, each their role
roles.description: One tavern, shielded roles. The GM steers, players see exactly what they're allowed to see.

gm.label: Game Master
gm.title: For the Game Master
gm.description: Build worlds, run combat and share revelations at your pace — without losing prep work.

player.label: Player
player.title: For the player
player.description: Step into your character, roll your dice and keep your backpack and notes close at hand.

free.name: Explorer
free.tagline: Start your first campaign — free, forever.

paid.name: GM Premium
paid.tagline: Unlimited worlds for the serious GM.

paid.name: Hero (Plus)
paid.tagline: Your characters and gear, across all campaigns.

start.q: Do I need anything to get started?
start.a: No. Create a free account, start a session as GM or join with a code as a player. Everything runs in your browser.

cost.a: TomeVault is free to use. Premium subscriptions unlock extras like unlimited campaigns, export and premium themes. Prices shown are indicative.

mobile.q: Does it work on my phone?
mobile.a: Yes. The table is built for desktop and mobile, so players can join from any screen.

upgrade.a: Absolutely. Start free and upgrade to Premium or Plus anytime — your campaigns and characters stay saved.

about.title: Atmosphere, focus and clarity
about.body: We build TomeVault for groups who put their story first, not their tooling. A calm digital tavern where handouts, chat, combat and notes come together — warm, cohesive and without noise.
